title: The Familiar face in the crowd
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：familiar　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 familiar 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the baker wrote of ① a familiar face in the crowd in the bill, and everybody in the bakery said at once that it was ② more familiar than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the baker, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the familiar ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most familiar face in the crowd anybody in the bakery had ever seen, or so the bill for December 1951 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too familiar to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the familiar ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a familiar smell of the kitchen, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as familiar as the smell of the kitchen they had once had in the old bakery. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was familiar or not, and he said so.

By 1964 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the bill. What the line asked for was ⑦ something familiar, and nothing besides. The customer from the next bakery called the whole plan ⑧ quite familiar; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the bill kept the names of the familiar ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1967, with great care, she wrote of another familiar face in the crowd in the same bill, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more familiar than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most familiar smell of the kitchen in the whole bakery, she said in 1969, was the one she could never quite name; the familiar ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 熟悉（前置定语 a familiar face in the crowd：1957 年面点师在账单里记下的那件熟悉的熟面孔）
B. adj. 熟悉／亲近（比较级 more familiar than：文中两处，一处比人群里的熟面孔，一处比预想）
C. adj. 熟悉／亲近（最高级 the most familiar：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 熟悉（表语 too familiar to do：母亲觉得它太熟悉，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 亲近（前置定语 a familiar smell of the kitchen：叔叔把整件事称作一桩亲近的气味）
F. adj. 亲近（同级比较 as familiar as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩厨房熟悉的气味相比）
G. adj. 亲近（后置定语 something familiar：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 亲近（受程度副词修饰 quite familiar：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: a familiar face in the crowd
the most familiar face in the crowd anybody
a familiar smell of the kitchen
The most familiar smell of the kitchen in

answers.why: familiar 意为“熟悉”，1957 年面点师在账单里记下的是“一件熟悉的熟面孔”，此处作前置定语 a familiar face in the crowd。
familiar 意为“熟悉”，此处用比较级 more familiar than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
familiar 意为“熟悉”，账单上 十二月 那行字说它是糕饼铺里最熟悉的一件，故用最高级 the most familiar face in the crowd。
familiar 意为“熟悉”，母亲认为这件东西“太熟悉了，谁也用不上”，too familiar to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
familiar 意为“亲近”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩亲近的气味”，此处作前置定语 a familiar smell of the kitchen。
familiar 意为“亲近”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩厨房熟悉的气味一样亲近”，同级比较用 as familiar as。
familiar 意为“亲近”，账单上那半行字要的是“亲近的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something familiar。
familiar 意为“亲近”，邻糕饼铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当亲近”，quite 修饰原级 familiar。
familiar 意为“亲近”，1967 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要亲近”，故用比较级 more familiar than。
familiar 意为“亲近”，母亲 1969 年说的是“整个糕饼铺里最亲近的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most familiar smell of the kitchen。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年，面点师在账单里记下了一件熟悉的熟面孔。（a familiar face in the crowd）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更熟悉。（more familiar than …）
母亲觉得它太熟悉，谁也用不上。（too familiar to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩亲近的气味。（a familiar smell of the kitchen）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩厨房熟悉的气味一样亲近。（as familiar as …）
到了 1964 年，账单上只剩半行字：要的是一件亲近的东西。（something familiar）
answers: In 1957 the baker wrote of a familiar face in the crowd in the bill.
Everybody said it was more familiar than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too familiar to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a familiar smell of the kitchen.
He said nobody would call it as familiar as the smell of the kitchen they had once had.
By 1964 the bill asked for nothing but something familiar.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 familiar 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the baker wrote of a familiar face in the crowd in the bill, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most familiar face in the crowd in the bakery, or so the bill says.
My mother thought it too familiar to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a familiar smell of the kitchen, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next bakery called the plan quite familiar, and everybody laughed.
The familiar ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
